column1: # Skills deliberately NOT in bin/lib/skill-routing.tsv — the coverage audit's allowlist.
# Every skills/**/*.md must either have a routing row (that is what makes it reachable) or a
# line here saying WHY it doesn't. An unrouted, unexempted skill fails
# `bin/render-routing.sh --check` — that is the point: orphans surface mechanically, not by
# someone happening to triage the directory. (Measured 2026-08-31, first run of this audit:
# 6 unrouted skills on disk — 3 were tombstones, but `full-harness-audit.md` and
# `test-result-audit.md` had ZERO inbound references anywhere in the repo, and
# `finding-disposition.md` was reachable only through other skills' prose.)
# Format: path<TAB>reason. `#` comments and blank lines ignored. A path ending in `/`
# exempts the whole directory. An exemption whose path no longer exists, or whose path HAS
# a routing row, is stale and reported — a dead exemption is a hole the audit can no longer
# Valid reasons are narrow: a tombstone (file kept so old links resolve, content moved or
# withdrawn), or a file reached by a dedicated mechanism other than the routing table. "We
# forgot" is not a reason — add the row instead.
